sections: Nucleus: NAD synthesis (R569 QNS1, R579 NMA1), the sirtuin step R567, the inherited nucleus-cytosol transports and the two new diffusions R_ADPRtn (ADP-ribose) and R_PPItn (diphosphate)
Cytosol: NAD synthesis (R580, R568, R578), ADP-ribose pyrophosphatase R1912 (YSA1), inorganic pyrophosphatase R419 (IPP1), nicotinamidase R576
GREYED: homocitrate synthase R396 and its acetyl-CoA / CoA / 2-oxoglutarate / acetate transports, R92 closed; blocked before and after, not changed
